title: 第二章黑木涯分别二第三章黑木涯分别三
content_zh:
王语嫣点了点头，两人合力推开棺盖。棺内躺着一具穿着金色铠甲的骸骨，骸骨手中握着一柄镶嵌着红宝石的弯刀，腰间挂着一个青铜令牌，令牌上刻着与影阁面具相似的藤蔓纹路，但更为繁复精美。
“这令牌……”王语嫣拿起令牌，指尖轻轻摩挲着纹路，“与影阁的标志同源，但年代更早，或许影阁的起源与乌孙国有关。”
萧琰接过令牌，只觉令牌入手冰凉，上面的纹路似乎蕴含着某种奇特的力量，他运转内力试探，令牌竟微微发热，散发出淡淡的红光。“这令牌或许不简单，我们先带着，说不定日后能派上用场。”
两人将棺盖恢复原状，在山洞内找了一处干燥的角落休息。王语嫣靠在石壁上，疲惫地闭上双眼：“萧公子，谢谢你一直保护我。若不是你，我恐怕早已落入影阁手中。”
萧琰看着她苍白的面容，心中生出一丝怜惜：“王姑娘不必客气，路见不平拔刀相助，本就是江湖儿女的本分。况且，影阁也与我有旧怨，此次正好一并了断。”
当晚，两人轮流守夜，次日清晨，待外面彻底安静后，才小心翼翼地走出山洞。为了避开影阁的搜寻，他们决定绕开大道，沿着赤水河向东而行，前往西域最大的城邦——楼兰古城。那里商贾云集，鱼龙混杂，或许能找到关于影阁的更多线索，也能暂时隐藏行踪。
赤水河蜿蜒向东，两岸是连绵的戈壁滩，偶尔能看到几簇顽强生长的骆驼刺。萧琰与王语嫣骑着“踏雪”，日夜兼程，历经三日，终于远远望见了楼兰古城的轮廓。古城坐落在沙漠与绿洲的交界处，城墙由土黄色的砖石砌成，历经千年风雨，依旧雄伟壮观，城头上飘扬着各色旗帜，彰显着这座城邦的繁华。
进入楼兰古城，街道两旁商铺林立，叫卖声不绝于耳。西域商人穿着色彩鲜艳的长袍，牵着骆驼穿梭在人群中；中原的商贩则摆着丝绸、茶叶的摊位，与西域商人讨价还价；还有来自波斯、大食的异域面孔，带来了香料、珠宝等奇珍异宝。
“这里真是热闹。”王语嫣好奇地打量着周围的一切，眼中满是惊叹。她自幼生活在江南姑苏，从未见过如此浓郁的异域风情。
萧琰牵着“踏雪”，警惕地观察着四周，生怕再次遇到影阁的人。“我们先找家客栈住下，再打听影阁的消息。”他说道，目光落在前方一家名为“楼兰居”的客栈上，客栈规模较大，门前停放着许多骆驼与马匹，看起来生意兴隆。
两人走进客栈，掌柜是一位留着络腮胡的西域男子，操着半生不熟的中原话问道：“两位客官，住店还是打尖？”
“来两间上房，再准备一些饭菜。”萧琰说道，同时将一块碎银子放在柜台上。
掌柜接过银子，脸上露出笑容：“好嘞，两间上房，饭菜马上就来。”他高声喊来店小二，吩咐其引两人上楼。
客房干净整洁，窗外正对着古城的中心广场。萧琰将青铜令牌取出，放在桌上，对王语嫣说道：“你先休息片刻，我去楼下打听消息，顺便看看能不能找到认识这令牌的人。”
王语嫣点了点头：“萧公子多加小心，若有危险，立刻回来。”
萧琰下楼后，来到客栈大堂的酒桌旁，点了一壶酒，假装不经意地与邻桌的一位老者闲聊。老者是一位常年往返于中原与西域的商人，见多识广。萧琰将青铜令牌悄悄取出，递到老者面前：“老丈，您见过这种令牌吗？”
老者接过令牌，仔细端详片刻，脸色骤变，连忙将令牌还给萧琰，压低声音说道：“小伙子，你这令牌是从哪里来的？这可是‘墨藤教’的圣物！”
“墨藤教？”萧琰心中疑惑，他从未听过这个教派。
老者喝了一口酒，缓缓说道：“墨藤教是千年前乌孙国的国教，崇拜墨藤神，教众以藤蔓为标志，行事狠辣，据说拥有操控毒物与机关的秘术。后来乌孙国灭亡，墨藤教也随之消失，没想到你竟能找到他们的圣物。”
萧琰心中一动，墨藤教的标志与影阁的面具相似，难道影阁是墨藤教的后裔？“老丈，您知道现在还有墨藤教的踪迹吗？”

老者摇了摇头：“多年前曾有人在西域见过戴着藤蔓面具的人，行事神秘，与当年的墨藤教颇为相似，但没人知道他们的巢穴在哪里。不过，三日后楼兰古城将举办‘西域珍宝大会’，据说会有一件与墨藤教有关的宝物现身，或许那些人会出现。”
萧琰谢过老者，回到客房，将打探到的消息告诉王语嫣。“珍宝大会……”王语嫣思索道，“影阁一直在寻找武学秘籍与奇珍异宝，他们肯定不会错过这个机会。我们可以趁机混入大会，寻找影阁的线索。”
接下来的三日，萧琰与王语嫣一边在楼兰古城中熟悉环境，一边准备参加珍宝大会的事宜。王语嫣凭借着对珠宝玉石的了解，挑选了几件西域特产的玉器，作为参加大会的“入场礼”；萧琰则暗中观察古城的防卫与地形，以防遇到危险时能及时脱身。
珍宝大会当天，古城中心广场搭建起一座巨大的高台，台上摆放着各种奇珍异宝，台下挤满了来自各地的商人、武林人士与贵族。萧琰与王语嫣混在人群中，目光紧紧盯着台上的宝物与周围的人群，寻找着影阁的踪迹。
大会进行到一半，主持人走上高台，高声宣布：“接下来要展示的，是本次大会的压轴宝物——墨藤教的‘藤萝心经’手稿！”
话音刚落，台下顿时一片哗然。萧琰与王语嫣对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了惊讶——影阁寻找的，竟然是《藤萝心经》！
就在此时，人群中突然传来一阵骚动，十几名戴着青铜面具的黑衣人从天而降，手持刀剑，朝着高台冲去。“是影阁的人！”王语嫣低声惊呼。
台上的护卫立刻拔刀抵抗，与黑衣人展开激战。萧琰拔出长剑，对王语嫣说道：“你在这里待着，不要乱跑，我去阻止他们！”
说完，萧琰纵身跃起，加入战局。他的《独孤九剑》变幻莫测，剑尖所指，皆是黑衣人的破绽。一名黑衣人挥刀向他砍来，萧琰侧身避开，长剑顺势刺入黑衣人的胸膛，黑衣人倒地身亡，面具脱落，露出一张布满疤痕的脸。
content_en:
Wang Yuyan nodded, and the two of them worked together to push open the coffin lid. Lying inside the coffin was a skeleton wearing golden armor. The skeleton held a scimitar inlaid with rubies in its hand, and a bronze token hung around its waist. The token was engraved with vine patterns similar to those of the Shadow Pavilion Mask, but more complicated and exquisite.
"This token..." Wang Yuyan picked up the token and gently rubbed the lines with her fingertips. "It has the same origin as the symbol of Shadow Pavilion, but it is older. Perhaps the origin of Shadow Pavilion is related to the Wusun Kingdom."
Xiao Yan took the token and felt that it was cold in his hand. The lines on it seemed to contain some kind of strange power. He used his inner strength to test it, and the token actually heated up slightly and emitted a faint red light. "This token may not be simple. Let's take it with us first. Maybe it can come in handy in the future."
The two restored the coffin lid to its original shape and found a dry corner to rest in the cave. Wang Yuyan leaned against the stone wall and closed her eyes tiredly: "Mr. Xiao, thank you for always protecting me. If it weren't for you, I would have fallen into the hands of the Shadow Pavilion."
Xiao Yan looked at her pale face and felt a trace of pity in his heart: "Miss Wang, there is no need to be polite. It is the duty of children of Jianghu to draw a sword to help when there is injustice. Besides, Yingge also has an old grudge with me, and this time we just put an end to it."
That night, the two took turns to keep vigil. The next morning, after it was completely quiet outside, they cautiously walked out of the cave. In order to avoid Shadow Pavilion's search, they decided to bypass the main road and walk eastward along the Chishui River to the largest city-state in the Western Region - the ancient city of Loulan. There are many merchants gathered there, and there is a mixture of fish and dragons. You may be able to find more clues about the Shadow Pavilion, or you can temporarily hide your whereabouts.
Chishui River meanders eastward, with continuous Gobi Desert on both sides. Occasionally, you can see a few clusters of tenacious camel thorns. Xiao Yan and Wang Yuyan rode the "Treading Snow" and traveled day and night. After three days, they finally saw the outline of the ancient city of Loulan from a distance. The ancient city is located at the junction of the desert and the oasis. The city wall is made of earth-yellow bricks and stones. After thousands of years of wind and rain, it is still majestic. Various flags are flying on the city head, highlighting the prosperity of this city-state.
Entering the ancient city of Loulan, there are many shops on both sides of the streets, and the sound of hawking is endless. Merchants from the Western Regions wore brightly colored robes and led camels through the crowd; merchants from the Central Plains set up stalls of silk and tea, bargaining with merchants from the Western Regions; there were also exotic faces from Persia and Dali, bringing spices, jewelry and other rare treasures.
"It's really lively here." Wang Yuyan looked at everything around her curiously, her eyes filled with wonder. She has lived in Suzhou in the south of the Yangtze River since she was a child, and has never seen such a rich exotic customs.
Xiao Yan held "Taxue" and watched the surroundings vigilantly, for fear of encountering the people from the Shadow Pavilion again. "Let's find an inn to stay in first, and then inquire about the Shadow Pavilion." He said, his eyes falling on an inn in front called "Lolan Ju". It was a large inn, with many camels and horses parked in front of the door. It seemed that business was booming.
The two of them walked into the inn. The innkeeper was a man from the Western Regions with a beard. He spoke in half-baked Chinese dialect and asked, "Two guests, do you want to stay in the hotel or stay in the hotel?"
"Come to the upper room and prepare some food." Xiao Yan said, while placing a piece of broken silver on the counter.
The shopkeeper took the money with a smile on his face: "Okay, two upper rooms, the food will be here soon." He loudly called the waiter and ordered him to lead the two of them upstairs.
The guest room is clean and tidy, and the window faces the central square of the ancient city. Xiao Yan took out the bronze token, put it on the table, and said to Wang Yuyan: "You rest for a while, I will go downstairs to inquire about the news, and see if I can find anyone who knows the token."
Wang Yuyan nodded: "Master Xiao, please be more careful. If there is any danger, come back immediately."
After Xiao Yan went downstairs, he came to the wine table in the lobby of the inn, ordered a bottle of wine, and pretended to casually chat with an old man at the next table. The old man is a man who travels between the Central Plains and the Western Regions all year round.A businessman who is well-informed. Xiao Yan quietly took out the bronze token and handed it to the old man: "Old man, have you seen this kind of token?"
The old man took the token, looked at it carefully for a moment, his expression suddenly changed, he quickly returned the token to Xiao Yan, and said in a low voice: "Young man, where did you get this token? This is the sacred object of the 'Moteng Sect'!"
"Mo Teng Sect?" Xiao Yan was confused. He had never heard of this sect.
The old man took a sip of wine and said slowly: "The Black Vine Sect was the state religion of the Wusun Kingdom a thousand years ago. It worshiped the Black Vine God. Its members used vines as symbols and acted ruthlessly. It is said that they had the secret skills to control poisons and mechanisms. Later, the Wusun Kingdom fell and the Black Vine Sect also disappeared. I didn't expect you to find their sacred objects."
Xiao Yan's heart moved. The symbol of the Moteng Sect is similar to the mask of the Shadow Pavilion. Could it be that the Shadow Pavilion is a descendant of the Moteng Sect? "My father-in-law, do you know that there are still traces of the Moteng Sect?"
The old man shook his head: "Many years ago, some people saw people wearing vine masks in the Western Regions. They acted mysteriously and were quite similar to the Black Vine Cult back then, but no one knew where their lair was. However, in three days, the ancient city of Loulan will hold the 'Western Region Treasure Conference'. It is said that a treasure related to the Black Vine Cult will appear. Maybe those people will show up."
Xiao Yan thanked the old man, returned to the guest room, and told Wang Yuyan the news. "Treasure Conference..." Wang Yuyan thought, "The Shadow Pavilion has been looking for martial arts secrets and rare treasures. They will definitely not miss this opportunity. We can take the opportunity to sneak into the conference and look for clues to the Shadow Pavilion."
In the next three days, Xiao Yan and Wang Yuyan were familiar with the environment in the ancient city of Loulan while preparing to attend the Treasure Conference. Relying on her knowledge of jewelry and jade, Wang Yuyan selected several pieces of jade that are specialties from the Western Regions as "entry gifts" to the conference; Xiao Yan secretly observed the defense and terrain of the ancient city in order to escape in time in case of danger.
On the day of the treasure conference, a huge high platform was built in the central square of the ancient city. Various rare treasures were placed on the platform. The audience was crowded with businessmen, martial arts people and nobles from all over the world. Xiao Yan and Wang Yuyan mingled among the crowd, staring closely at the treasures on the stage and the crowd around them, looking for traces of Shadow Pavilion.
Halfway through the conference, the host walked up to the high platform and announced loudly: "What I will show next is the final treasure of this conference - the manuscript of the 'Wengluo Heart Sutra' of the Moten Sect!"
As soon as he finished speaking, there was an uproar in the audience. Xiao Yan and Wang Yuyan looked at each other, and both saw surprise in each other's eyes - what Yingge was looking for turned out to be the "Wengluo Heart Sutra"!
At this moment, there was a sudden commotion in the crowd, and a dozen men in black wearing bronze masks fell from the sky, holding swords, and rushed towards the high platform. "It's from Yingge!" Wang Yuyan exclaimed in a low voice.
The guards on the stage immediately drew their swords to resist and started a fierce battle with the man in black. Xiao Yan pulled out his long sword and said to Wang Yuyan: "Stay here and don't run around. I'll stop them!"
After saying that, Xiao Yan jumped up and joined the battle. His "Nine Swords of Dugu" is unpredictable, and whatever the tip of the sword points at is the man in black's flaw. A man in black slashed at him with a knife. Xiao Yan sidestepped and pierced the chest of the man in black. The man in black fell to the ground and died. His mask fell off, revealing a face covered with scars.
